fact: Car 44 left the track at Turn 8 at 20:22, while defending a position and gained a lasting advantage.
offence: Breach of Article B1.8.6 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, timing and in-car video evidence. Car 1 (NOR) attempted to overtake Car 44 (HAM) on the left-hand side approaching Turn 7. At the apex, the front axle of Car 1 was at least alongside of the mirror of Car 44. Applying the Driving Standards Guidelines, the Stewards determined that Car 1 was entitled to the corner. Car 44 remained alongside Car 1 and subsequently crossed the white line on the right-hand side, leaving the track. By doing so, Car 44 avoided a potential collision but maintained its position ahead of Car 1. By leaving the track while defending, Car 44 therefore is considered as having gained a lasting advantage. Car 44 did not concede the position to Car 1, as he should have done. The Stewards therefore determined that Car 44 had left the track and gained a lasting advantage.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 44 Leaving The Track And Gaining An Advantage
